objective: compare the out-of-year learnability of future path labels before selecting a successor model target

data.row_universe: all point-in-time main-board candidates without future fill or label filtering
data.feature_profile: 296 continuous and 5 train-mapped categorical causal features

folds.train_window: expanding from the first candidate date
folds.sample_weight: each signal date has equal total weight within each target
folds.fold_role: discovery and evaluation with common early stopping, not a pristine holdout

state: binary and multiclass Brier and log-loss skill
evaluation.overlap_control: Newey-West HAC on daily metrics with lag H-1; retain monthly aggregates

decision.common_gates: all three years positive Rank IC and Top5 lift; every year passes minimum decile monotonicity; Top1 lift is positive in at least two years; worst-year Rank IC and HAC support pass
decision.g_and_mfe_extra_gate: Top5 positive-return-rate enrichment is positive in all three years
decision.state_extra_gate: binary high-state and multiclass Brier skill are positive in all three years
decision.family_order: qualified horizon count, median qualified worst-year Rank IC, then simplicity tie-break g over mfe over state
decision.pre_peak_mae_role: auxiliary risk output only when its own horizon qualifies
